blocks.text: Mastering Excel for financial controllers on Mac

Financial controllers spend significant time on the month end close. This process often takes 5 to 10 days of intense work. You are likely downloading reports, reformatting data, and performing variance analysis. Excel remains your primary tool for these tasks. You can improve your efficiency by learning specific keyboard shortcuts. Use Fn + F2 to edit a cell quickly. Use Cmd + T to create a table. These small changes save minutes every hour.

Much of your time goes into the coordination layer. You chase department heads for explanations. You search through email threads for the latest version of a report. This administrative burden is often called the coordination tax. Use native Mac tools to manage this. SupaSidebar helps you organize browser tabs by project. 1Password keeps your financial logins secure and accessible.
Essential Excel tips for finance professionals

items: Use XLOOKUP instead of VLOOKUP to search data to the left.
Freeze panes to keep headers visible while you scroll through large datasets.
Use data validation to create drop down lists for consistent input.
Remove duplicates to ensure your trial balance is accurate.
Use IFERROR to keep your financial models clean and readable.

blocks.text: Excel supports over one million rows per sheet. However, performance can drop with complex formulas. Keep your files efficient. Use named ranges to make formulas easier to read. Avoid volatile functions like INDIRECT or OFFSET when possible. If your sheet slows down, try to convert some formulas to static values. Copy the cells and use Paste Special > Values.
Working with Lazur on your Mac

Lazur lives in your Mac notch. It helps you get work done in any app. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask a question about your screen. Lazur answers out loud. If you cannot find a specific setting in Excel, ask Lazur. It will draw a circle around the button for you. This is faster than hunting through the ribbon menus.

faq.question: Can Lazur edit my Excel files directly?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons, edit files, or operate apps for you. It points at things on your screen and provides guidance.

faq.question: Does Excel for Mac support all Windows features?
faq.answer: Most core features are the same, but some advanced automation or specific add ins may differ. Check the Microsoft support site for version specific details.

faq.question: How do I fix the leading zero issue in Excel?
faq.answer: Select the cells, right click, and choose Format Cells. Select the Text category to preserve leading zeros.
